title: Digital Personal Data Protection (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2026

sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.text:
(1) This Order may be called the Digital Personal Data Protection (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2026.

(2) It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

sections.title: Substitutions in sections 9 and 10 of the Act
sections.text:
In the said Act,—

  1. in section 9, in sub-section (1), for the words “ child or a person with disability,” the words “child or of a person with disability ”shall be substituted;
  2. in section 10, in sub-section (2), in clause (c), in sub-clause (ii), for the word “audit”, the words “data audit” shall be substituted;

[F. No. AA-11038/8/2025-CL&ES]

AJIT KUMAR, Jt. Secy.
